newsitem.title: CANADA: Newalta sets C$10.8 mln share placement.
newsitem.headline: Newalta sets C$10.8 mln share placement.

text.p: Newalta Corp said on Wednesday it entered into an agreement with Sprott Securities Ltd to sell 1.35 million common shares by way of a private placement at a price of C$8.00 per share.
Proceeds of the C$10.8 million private placement will be used to support Newalta's "aggressive growth plans," in the waste management business, Newalta said.
Closing of the private placement, expected to be on or before January 24, is conditional upon documentation and receipt of all regulatory approvals, Newalta said.
